newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT- Sharp maintained as buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT- Sharp maintained as buy.

text.p: -- Fator Securities said it maintained a buy rating on Brazilian electronics firm Sharp.

-- The brokerage said Sharp's sales in the first nine months rose 11 percent to 721 million reais, compared with the same period last year, and projects a 13-percent rise for all of 1996 versus last year.
-- Sharp posted a 9.5 million real loss from January to September, roughly equal to the loss in the same period in 1995, as greater competition drove down prices, it said.
-- "Losses should reverse in the fourth quarter due to greater sales volume," Fator added.
-- The brokerage said prospects for the TV market are still good, with 1996 sales forecast at nine million sets and rising to 11 million sets next year, versus prior forecasts of 12.5 million.
-- Sharp's preferred was off 0.03 reais at 1.52 reais while its common was untraded on the Sao Paulo bourse.
